subject: Intro + quick qualification: OliveTech pilot?
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + quick qualification: OliveTech pilot?

Hi Sara — thanks for signing up with Redwood and for the quick notes in your intake form. Before we lock a demo slot I want to confirm a few fit details so the session is focused and we can bring the right people. Short questions below (answers in-line or as a quick reply is perfect):

1) Primary use case: are you evaluating Redwood for
   - live customer-support search/ranking (low-latency), or
   - batch embeddings for similarity search (higher throughput), or
   - a mix?

2) Traffic profile: rough monthly generation (tokens or requests) and expected peak concurrency (e.g., 500 reqs/min)

3) Typical sequence length / average prompt + response tokens (helps with model recommendation)

4) Pilot timeline: are you aiming for a 2–4 week internal pilot in June/July, or later in Q3?

5) Any compliance constraints (data residency, VPN/VPC, SOC2) we should plan for on the demo?

If it helps, I attached a short pilot scope template you can fill (pilot_scope_template.xlsx) — one page, very light.

I have availability for a 30-minute walkthrough next week: Tue 6/1 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed 6/2 09:00–12:00 PT. If those don't work, book a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/mateo/30min

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
SDR, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: pilot_scope_template.xlsx (xlsx, 1 page intake template)

From: Sara Lim <sara@olivetech.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + quick qualification: OliveTech pilot?

Hi Mateo — thanks for the quick note. Answers below: 

1) Primary use case: customer-support search & ranking for our knowledge base (low-latency path), with an experimental embeddings index for suggested articles.

2) Traffic profile: roughly 5M tokens/month today, ramping to ~15M tokens/month in three months. Peak concurrency is around 30–50 concurrent queries at our busiest times.

3) Sequence length: typical user query ~20–40 tokens, responses range 80–220 tokens (average ~150 tokens).

4) Pilot timeline: we'd like a small internal pilot starting mid-June, production decision by end of July.

5) Compliance: data residency in US preferred; SOC2 is important later but not required for pilot.

I've attached a short internal traffic snapshot (we can send a sanitized CSV if helpful). We can do next week — Tue 6/1 at 10:00 PT works for me. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Sara Lim
Head of Product, OliveTech
sara@olivetech.com

--
Attachment: olive_traffic_snapshot_summary.pdf (pdf, 1 page summary)

Great — thanks for the fast answers, Sara. That profile looks like a good fit for a low-latency demo + pilot plan. A couple of quick clarifying notes so we bring the right tech folks: 

- When you say "responses range 80–220 tokens", are there specific endpoints that will produce the long-form content (e.g., knowledge-augmented generator) vs short ranking calls? If you can flag the percentage of requests that are ranking-only vs generation that helps sizing.

Next steps: I booked Tue 6/1 10:00 PT tentatively on my calendar and sent a short intake link — feel free to update the pilot_scope_template.xlsx with the traffic numbers or attach the sanitized CSV (see traffic_sample_instructions.pdf for how we prefer the sample). I'll convert the tentative into an invite once we confirm Tom can make it. If anything changes, here's a direct link to reschedule: https://cal.redwood.ai/mateo/30min

Mateo
